Mechanical setup for llm-dlc/loops/in-the-loop-blind-caller-and-pr-verification-brief.md. Every deployment file of the 120 numbered examples the brief names (the P/Q/R draw inventory 478-587, N01-N05, the M04/M06/M09 controls, 458, 466) matches its runtime.json digest, with a worktree at each pin; J08, J14, Log4j #1173 and Commons IO #520 match at their readers' paths. The registered observations of 458, 466, 484, J08, J14 and Commons IO were re-run on the original JVMs and equal their receipts. For part B, the setup prepared plain-JVM launches of the original upstream tests: Spring #37193's landed ServerSentEventHttpMessageReaderTests on the kept 202-entry test classpaths (fix 14/14, parent 13/13, fix-on-parent fails ignoreInvalidRetry, on JDKs 25 and 17), and Parquet #3638's parquet-column and parquet-hadoop test trees compiled at both pins over the original 113-entry graphs (landed TestDictionary fails twice on the parent, TestParquetWriter passes on both). Only test dependencies and JUnit console launchers were fetched, from Maven Central with strict checksums and signatures checked in a private keyring; one jar's signing key is unpublished. No claims, examples, adapters or library code were written.

Jobs 20261127-032247-setup-replay-the-p-q-r-n-and-m-public-ob (replay the P, Q, R, N and M campaign observations at this head and compare with the committed audits) and 20261127-032259-setup-run-parquet-3638-s-upstream-parque (Parquet's full upstream suites on the overlays) are pending.
